text: I think you'll really enjoy this Mini Quiche recipe! It's a great option because it's quick and easy to make, taking only about 22 minutes to prepare. The combination of bacon, onion, and cheese will give you a rich and savory flavor, while the eggs and cream add a creamy texture. Plus, it's a relatively small serving size, so you can indulge without feeling too guilty. Overall, it's a satisfying and filling dish that should fit within your 30-minute time budget.
